title: Fix the stale "50%" coverage-floor comment in ci.yml (actual floor is 60%)
why: The section header comment says the floor is 50%, but the step name ('Assert coverage floor ≥ 60%') and the enforced FLOOR=60 variable both say 60% — someone raised the floor and updated the step but not the section comment. Low-impact (the enforced value is correct and stricter than the comment implies) but misleads anyone skimming section headers to understand the pipeline.
recommendation: Update the comment to '(60% line coverage, always enforced)'.
acceptance_criteria: The section-6 comment states the same percentage as the FLOOR variable.
